title: On mesh patterns of short length: Equidistribution and enumeration
summary: The classification and enumeration of short mesh patterns have emerged as two central directions in the area. We make substantial progress on both fronts. We construct an involution and a bijection that establish distributional equivalences for two classes of length-$2$ mesh patterns, thereby resolving a conjecture from 2019 and a recent conjecture. As a consequence, the best known upper bounds for the numbers of distribution-equivalence and Wilf-equivalence classes drop to $106$ and $47$, respectively.
